title: optimize-quant-kernels-int8-fp8-smoothquant-dequant-fusion-kvcache-batching
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: reduce memory traffic and per-token compute for quantized inference by fusing dequant + GEMM and integrating smoothquant weight preprocessing into the fused path. This PR implements a fused INT8/FP8 kernel, wiring into the KV-cache and continuous batching codepaths, and adds feature flags so we can rollout safely. Summary of changes: - New fused kernels that perform dequantization and matrix multiply in a single pass (INT8 and FP8 variants). - SmoothQuant preprocessing integrated as an optional weight transform that is applied at model load time and can be toggled per-deployment. - KV-cache compatibility: fused-kernel entrypoints that accept cached KV layouts to avoid extra memory copies. - Batcher logic updated to prefer fused kernels when shapes and quant profiles match. - Extensive microbench harness and regression tests. Checklist: [x] fused kernel implementation for INT8 [x] fused kernel implementation for FP8 [x] smoothquant weight preprocessing and toggles [x] KV-cache integration and tests [x] continuous batcher heuristics + opt-out flag [x] benchmarks and docs Linear links: ENG-10234 (quant kernel roadmap), ENG-10890 (kvcache + batching), related support ticket SUP-8721. Rollout plan: merge gated behind feature flag `quant_fused.enable` (default off), rollout to canary pool, monitor latency and regression tests, then enable by default on supported GPU families.

Diego Martinez: Microbench results look promising but we need more coverage on sequence lengths >2048.\nAisha Khan: Added tests for variable sequence lengths (64/512/2048/4096) and updated benchmark section.
Priya Shah: Please ensure no change in FP32 baseline behavior.\nAisha Khan: Verified FP32 paths untouched; added regression checks to CI that compare FP32 outputs pre/post change.
benchmarks: INT8 fused kernel throughput: 22.4k tokens/s vs 15.1k baseline (+48%) on A100-like GPU
FP8 fused kernel throughput: 19.8k tokens/s vs 13.3k baseline (+49%) on A100-like GPU
End-to-end 95p latency reduction on 8k batch workload: 31% lower when using fused kernels and KV-cache
notes: Implements smoothquant preprocessing and fuses dequant + GEMM to reduce memory traffic and improve cache locality.
Exposes fused-kernel entrypoints compatible with existing KV-cache layouts to avoid extra copies during cache rehydration.
Updates continuous batcher heuristics to prefer fused kernels when request shapes and quantization profiles match; includes safety opt-out flag for older drivers/architectures.
Feature flagged rollout allows rapid rollback if driver issues or numerical regressions are detected in canary environments.
release_notes: Performance: fused INT8/FP8 kernels with smoothquant and dequant fusion reduce per-token compute and memory traffic; expect ~40-50% throughput improvements on supported GPUs. Rollout behind feature flag.
